content: {"action":"appeal_with_necessity","reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 for missing prior authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Correcting the invalid diagnosis pairing would not cure the authorization denial, while billing the patient for the full balance would exceed the contractual 10% share. A formal appeal supported by the strongest available medical-necessity documentation is the only available action that can properly pursue payer reimbursement."}
